data.name: The Untamed realms
data.detailed_description:
Explore the Untamed Realms

Venture across a massive open world filled with ancient ruins, dangerous wilderness, hidden secrets, and powerful Ecomon waiting to be discovered. From dense forests and towering mountains to mysterious swamps and forgotten islands, every region offers new adventures and rare creatures to uncover.

Capture, Train, and Battle Ecomon

Discover unique Ecomon across the world and build your perfect team. Each creature brings its own abilities, strengths, and combat styles into battle.

Train your Ecomon, evolve your strategies, and take on dangerous wild creatures, powerful bosses, and rival tamers throughout your journey.

Adventure Online With Friends

Explore the world solo or alongside friends in online multiplayer adventures. Travel together, battle powerful creatures, build bases, trade Ecomon, and challenge other players across the untamed realms.

Build, Craft, and Survive

Gather resources from the world around you to craft tools, equipment, shelters, and supplies for your adventures. Create your own camps and prepare your team for the dangers hidden across the wilderness.

Discover a Living World

The untamed realms are filled with dynamic environments, rare encounters, dangerous creatures, and hidden locations waiting to be explored. Every journey into the wild could lead to new discoveries, powerful Ecomon, or unexpected dangers.

Planned Features

  • Open-world exploration

  • Creature collecting and team building

  • Online multiplayer adventures

  • Ecomon battles and progression

  • Crafting and survival systems

  • Base building

  • Character customization

  • Diverse biomes and environments

  • Rare creatures and boss encounters

  • Ongoing content updates during Early Access

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 1903 and newer versions
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen R5-1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
